changes: The CC Receive tables are now saved on the +Drive, one set for the whole unit, and come back after a power cycle.
They are written about a second after your last change, to two files in turn, so a power cut during a save keeps the previous tables.
A new or formatted +Drive starts at the stock 70–77, as before.
Tested on a Digitakt I, alone and with CC Assignment Names.
First release for Digitakt I OS 1.54, on Core 2.1. Press AMP again on a MIDI track's AMP page for CC Receive, where knobs A–H choose the incoming CC for VAL1–VAL8.
A CC with that number on the track's own channel moves the VAL slot as CC 70–77 does stock, so a controller with fixed CC numbers can play the track.
Every slot starts at 70–77, so an untouched table is stock. One table per MIDI track, for all patterns.
The tables are not saved and start at 70–77 at every power-on.
Tested on a Digitakt I with a fixed-CC controller, alone, with FX Track and with CC Assignment Names. Copying a MIDI track does not copy its table.
